description_full:
[STAFF INTERN]

This position is open to law students and fresh graduates who are enthusiastic about starting their professional careers in the fields of criminal law, civil law, and corporate law. The application deadline is November 19, 2026.

Submit your CV, including at least one non-private social media account for screening purposes.

Email: leon@leopartnerslaw.com
